generated_from: Pinned upstream recursive Git tree plus inspected codec/consumer classes
invariant: Every record remains tied to its upstream blob SHA; family metadata describes the decoding/loading boundary and primary runtime consumers.

biome_layer_stack.purpose: Composable biome-layer configuration feeding the Twilight biome density/source pipeline.

biome_terrain_data.purpose: Per-biome terrain columns and biome-layer configuration used by the current density pipeline.

chunk_blanket_processors.purpose: Post-surface chunk blanket effects such as dark-forest canopy and glacier processing.

dwarf_rabbit_variant.purpose: Data-selected rabbit texture/biome variants, persisted through registry keys.

magic_paintings.purpose: Layered painting dimensions, textures, parallax and opacity behavior used directly by entity and renderer.

quests.purpose: Reloadable quest definition data for Questing Ram behavior and synchronization.

restrictions.purpose: Biome progression gates selecting structure hints, enforcement behavior, multiplier, toast and required advancements.

stalactites.purpose: Reloadable speleothem pools and entries used by hollow hills/caves and related structures.

structure_speleothem_settings.purpose: Per-structure lattice and speleothem variety selection.

template_definition.purpose: Weighted template pool definitions compiled at reload time and reservoir-sampled by structure generation.

template_marker_handler_list.purpose: Composable marker-handler sequences for template data markers.

tiny_bird_variant.purpose: Data-selected bird texture/biome variants consumed by entity state and renderer.

travellers_modifiers.purpose: Polymorphic gear abilities/modifiers dispatching through a registry of modifier MapCodecs.

wood_palettes.purpose: Replaceable wood-family block palettes used by structure processing.
